findings.title: Layer isolation violation: Web project directly references Infrastructure layer
findings.rule_violated: Clean Architecture: Dependency Rule (Web should only depend on Core + Services, not Infrastructure)
findings.remediation: Move all Infrastructure initialization (EF Core, SQLite init) into the Services layer's DI extension method (ServiceCollectionExtensions.AddContestJudgingServices). Remove the ProjectReference to Infrastructure from Web.csproj and the EF Core/SQLite PackageReferences. Web should only reference Services (and Core for entities).

findings.title: E2E test project not included in solution file
findings.rule_violated: Solution Completeness (all buildable projects must be in the solution)
findings.remediation: Fixed. E2E project now included in solution.

findings.title: E2E tests reference packages not declared in Directory.Packages.props (central package management violation)
findings.evidence_snippet:
Directory.Packages.props now includes PackageVersion entries for all E2E packages:
  <PackageVersion Include="NUnit" Version="4.3.2" />
  <PackageVersion Include="NUnit.Analyzers" Version="4.6.0" />
  <PackageVersion Include="NUnit3TestAdapter" Version="5.0.0" />
  <PackageVersion Include="Microsoft.Playwright.NUnit" Version="1.52.0" />
findings.rule_violated: Central Package Management: all PackageReference items must have a corresponding PackageVersion in Directory.Packages.props

findings.title: E2ETests project missing explicit RootNamespace and AssemblyName properties
findings.evidence_snippet: E2ETests.csproj still has no <RootNamespace> or <AssemblyName>. All other projects (Core, Infrastructure, Services, Web, Tests) define these explicitly in their PropertyGroup.
findings.rule_violated: Project Convention Consistency (all projects should use explicit RootNamespace/AssemblyName)

findings.title: Orphaned scaffolding placeholder file in Infrastructure project
findings.evidence_snippet: src/ContestJudging.Infrastructure/Class1.cs no longer exists on disk. Only 3 legitimate .cs files remain: ContestDbContext.cs, SqliteRepositories.cs, DatabaseBackupService.cs.

findings.title: Mixed test frameworks across test projects
findings.evidence_snippet: Unit tests use xunit; E2E tests use NUnit + Playwright; Web.Tests uses xunit + bunit. The addition of a third test project (Web.Tests) with xunit means one test project (E2E) uses NUnit while two use xunit.
findings.rule_violated: Testing Consistency (single test framework per solution is standard practice)
findings.remediation: Either convert E2E tests to xUnit (matching the unit test projects) or document the rationale for two frameworks. If E2E tests use NUnit for Playwright integration, add a note in the project README.

findings.title: .gitignore missing SQLite database file patterns
findings.evidence_snippet: contest.db is the SQLite filename used throughout the project (see DatabaseBackupService.cs referencing 'contest.db'). .gitignore still has no *.db, *.sqlite, or *.sqlite3 patterns.
findings.rule_violated: Git Hygiene (build/runtime artifacts should be gitignored)
findings.remediation: Add '*.db', '*.sqlite', and '*.sqlite3' patterns to .gitignore to prevent accidentally committing SQLite database files.

findings.title: Redundant TargetFramework/Nullable/ImplicitUsings overrides in Web.csproj
findings.rule_violated: DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself) / Build configuration conventions
findings.remediation: Remove the TargetFramework, Nullable, and ImplicitUsings properties from Web.csproj's PropertyGroup; rely on Directory.Build.props inheritance.

findings.title: Orphaned testapp scaffold project outside solution
findings.evidence_snippet: testapp/ directory persists on disk with 62 files (excluding obj/bin). Git status shows it as untracked (??). It was never committed, but still pollutes the working tree. Contains a standalone Blazor WASM scaffold with hardcoded package versions (bypasses Directory.Packages.props), non-standard namespace 'testapp', and large wwwroot/lib/bootstrap/ assets.
findings.rule_violated: Solution Hygiene (no orphaned/unreferenced projects in working tree)
findings.remediation: Delete the entire testapp/ directory. Add 'testapp/' to .gitignore if warranted for local development tooling artifacts.

findings.title: Trim analyzer enabled globally but EF Core (Infrastructure) is not trimming-safe
findings.evidence_snippet: Directory.Build.props still applies <IsTrimmable>true</IsTrimmable> and <EnableTrimAnalyzer>true</EnableTrimAnalyzer> to ALL projects. This now causes 10 IL2026 trim warnings in the new tests/ContestJudging.Web.Tests/ModelValidationTests.cs (Validator.TryValidateObject + ValidationContext constructors). Infrastructure still uses [RequiresUnreferencedCode] attribute, and Web still suppresses IL2111.
findings.rule_violated: Build Configuration (trim settings should be scoped to the published project, not class libraries)
findings.remediation: Move <IsTrimmable> and <EnableTrimAnalyzer> from Directory.Build.props into the Web.csproj PropertyGroup. Class libraries (Core, Infrastructure, Services) should not be marked trimmable. Or scope with a Condition="'$(IsPublishable)' == 'true'".

findings.title: Web.Tests project missing explicit RootNamespace and AssemblyName properties
findings.evidence_snippet: The newly added Web.Tests.csproj (created by R3-B remediation) has no <RootNamespace> or <AssemblyName> elements. All other projects in the solution (Core, Infrastructure, Services, Web, and unit Tests) define these explicitly.
findings.rule_violated: Project Convention Consistency (all projects should use explicit RootNamespace/AssemblyName)

findings.title: Redundant TargetFramework/Nullable overrides in E2ETests.csproj and Web.Tests.csproj
findings.evidence_snippet:
Both test projects duplicate Directory.Build.props values:
E2ETests: <TargetFramework>net10.0</TargetFramework>, <ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>, <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
Web.Tests: <TargetFramework>net10.0</TargetFramework>, <Nullable>enable</Nullable>

Same pattern as STRUCT-008 (Web.csproj).
findings.rule_violated: DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself) / Build configuration conventions
findings.remediation: Remove the redundant TargetFramework, Nullable, and ImplicitUsings properties from E2ETests.csproj and Web.Tests.csproj; rely on Directory.Build.props inheritance.

findings.title: E2ETests.csproj uses non-standard LangVersion=latest override
findings.evidence_snippet: E2ETests.csproj contains <LangVersion>latest</LangVersion>. No other project in the solution overrides LangVersion. With net10.0 TFM, the default LangVersion already maps to C# 14 (latest). This explicit override is redundant and introduces inconsistency.
findings.rule_violated: Build Configuration Consistency (unnecessary LangVersion overrides fragment the build contract)
findings.remediation: Remove the <LangVersion>latest</LangVersion> line from E2ETests.csproj. Rely on the TFM-implied default.

findings.title: Stale testapp/ directory persists on disk with 62 untracked scaffold files
findings.evidence_snippet: The testapp/ directory remains on disk with 62 files (excluding obj/). git status shows '?? testapp/'. It was never committed but was also never cleaned up. Contains: a standalone Blazor WASM scaffold with hardcoded PackageReference versions (bypasses CPM), empty scaffold pages (Counter, Weather, Home), bootstrap 5.x assets, and stale obj/ build artifacts.
findings.rule_violated: Solution Hygiene (no orphaned scaffold remnants in working tree)
findings.remediation: Delete the entire testapp/ directory. Optionally add 'testapp/' to .gitignore to prevent reoccurrence. The directory's files were never committed to git history so no history is lost.
